row.notes: Converts a normalized viewport rect {x,y,w,h} and target size into a 0xa0-byte constant block: +0x00 snapped normalized rect (min,max), +0x10 integer pixel rect {x,y,w,h}, +0x20 inverse rect size, +0x30/+0x40 pixel to NDC scale/offset (with half-texel -0.5), +0x50/+0x60 NDC to UV scale/offset, +0x70 inverse UV extent, +0x80 UV to NDC scale/offset, +0x90 {1/w, 1/h, 0.5/w, 0.5/h} of the target. Zeroes the transforms when the rect is empty. Useful for custom viewport or split-screen mods.
